answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that unlocks only after a long, verifiable service history. A fresh identity starts at its nadir - zero trust, tiny job caps - and must earn standing through completed work, not self-asserted claims. Cheap clones can wander in freely, but each one restarts at the bottom, so an attacker pays the full time-and-stake delta for every fake identity, while honest agents keep the reputation they built.
